files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Culvert on the Meridian Highway in Pierce County, Nebraska, running under county road 552 Ave just north of the intersection with county road 852 Rd; seen from the east.  This is part of a 4.5-mile (7.2 km) segment of the highway that is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.  The concrete culverts and 4-foot (1.2 m) concrete markers were installed in 1920.
